channel.title: LSU Morning Brief
channel.description: Daily LSU football morning brief - Tiger Droppings buzz, local radio/YouTube, and headlines. Unlisted personal feed.
channel.itunes:author: LSU football news
channel.itunes:summary: Daily LSU football morning brief for personal listening.

item.title: Fri Oct 9 - Kiffin blasts SEC transfer rule; Isaias heads for Lexington; Pate says two-plus TDs
item.description: Kiffin on his radio show: proposed SEC year-in-residence rule for intraconference transfers would be terrible, other conferences would celebrate it. TD rips Sankey. Kiffin on Leavitt's hamstring keeping him in the pocket, receivers' confidence, Harlem Berry, Kentucky's physical run game and opportunistic defense. Dane Stevens and Tamarcus Cooley. Isaias landfall tonight, rain and 20 mph gusts at kickoff. Josh Pate on McElroy and Cubelic: LSU by two-plus touchdowns. Injury report quiet. OTB, AFR, Locked On, TD road warriors. Sat 6:05 CT ESPN.

item.title: Thu Oct 8 - Fake Minchey quote on the LSU screen; Kentucky thin at LB; Isaias a hurricane
item.description: A fabricated Kenny Minchey quote shows up inside LSU Football Ops; KSR says he never said it, Stein says no locker room material, Kiffin says he hasn't seen it. Kiffin on the teleconference: sees some of his young self in Stein, portal teams get stronger late. Injury report: no LSU surprises, Leavitt not listed; Kentucky out three inside linebackers, long snapper questionable. Dottery wears the green dot. Hurricane Isaias aimed at the Mississippi and Alabama coast; wet Saturday night in Lexington. Contempt motion vs. SEC, Sankey and LSU. TD buzz, Klatt says LSU can make an SEC title run, Pate JP Poll No. 8, Locked On, AFR with Aliou Bah, Off The Bench. Sat 6 CT ESPN, LSU by about 8.5.

item.title: Wed Oct 7 - Leavitt says 100 percent by Saturday; Stein praises Kiffin; Isaias in the Gulf
item.description: Leavitt Tuesday: "super light hamstring thing," 100 percent by Saturday, quarterback first and playmaker second. Moore: zero sacks the last two games; Dottery leads with 28 tackles. Green still no date. Will Stein in the Power K: LSU elite team, elite coach; Kiffin an elite offensive mind; Minchey "greasy"; Kentucky struggles with running QBs. Kentucky sold out for homecoming. Tropical Storm Isaias in the Gulf. TD buzz: weather apps, Ben Garrett play-call claim, chip on the shoulder, 547.8 yards a game. Finebaum and Pate on LSU. Easton Royal visits set. Sat 6 CT ESPN, LSU by about 10.

item.title: Tue Oct 6 - Kiffin opens Kentucky week: Green closer, Leavitt stays in the pocket
item.description: Kiffin Monday presser: Trey'Dez Green out of the brace and getting closer (no date), Weeks a late-season hope. Leavitt 35/46, 489 yds, 5 TD, 1 INT, 0 sacks over two games. Dottery green dot not permanent. Kentucky has Joe Sloan and Nic Anderson. TD buzz: Baker vs Sloan, 6 straight SEC road losses, is this team elite. Miss. State set for Oct 17 at 11 CT. National: Brad Crawford and Crain and Cone say Kentucky is dangerous. Sat 6 CT ESPN, LSU by 8.5 to 10.

item.title: Mon Oct 5 - Back to No. 10; Kiffin still furious; Kentucky week opens
item.description: LSU climbs to No. 10 in the AP poll, one spot behind Ole Miss; Kentucky tops receiving votes. Kiffin Sunday: no major injuries for the first time in a long time, but ripped two long TDs and unready QBs. Leavitt better, still not running (8 TD, 7 INT). Dottery wears the green dot. Will Stein's 4-1 Kentucky: Minchey 11 TD, 1 INT, last in FBS on third down. Princewill vs Lance Heard; Geralds makes program history. TD buzz, Pate's Florida-2019 LSU flop. Sat 6 CT ESPN, LSU by 10.

item.title: Sun Oct 4 - LSU 63-14 McNeese; historic 731 yards; Leavitt protected; Kentucky next
item.description: No. 11 LSU buried McNeese 63-14: 731 yards (2nd-most in program history), school-record 101 plays and 39 first downs. Leavitt started protected (18/23, 176, 3 TD, INT, 0 rushes); Clark second half. Barber 2 scores; Berry 125; Gage 2 long TDs; Geralds sack+offensive TD (program first). Clean injury night. Next: at Kentucky Sat 6 CT ESPN after UK OT win at South Carolina.

item.title: Sat Oct 3 - Gameday McNeese: wet Death Valley; Clark runway; Kiffin extremely cautious
item.description: Gameday: No. 11 LSU hosts McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN, ~50-53.5 favs. WBRZ wet night (rain past kick). Kiffin extremely cautious / full faith in Clark; Advocate beat leans Clark heavy or every snap; Leavitt hammy likely limited/shelved. Weeks extended; Ross/Spears season ACLs; Green targeting Alabama; LB Keys/Dottery/Singleton. TD split on Start Clark. Soft window then Kentucky next Sat.

item.title: Fri Oct 2 - Kiffin radio puts Singleton in; Clark door open; wet Death Valley
item.description: One day out: McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN, ~48.5-pt favs. Kiffin radio (Court to Table): Singleton will play at LB with Keys/Dottery. Clark start door still open (Hunt Palmer/Yahoo); Lippold vs Leavitt/Clark/Longstreet. WAFB wet weekend 2-4 in BR, rain gear for Death Valley. Weeks out a while; Green targeting Alabama; Ross/Spears season ACLs. OTB hour three looking ahead. Soft window closes after Saturday.

item.title: Thu Oct 1 - Clark door open vs McNeese; Kelly first-down note; in-state spotlight
item.description: Two days out: LSU ~48.5-pt favs over McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN. Kiffin leaves Clark start door open; TD board majority wants Leavitt sat. Weeks surgery done, no return date; Keys/Dottery green-dot; Green targeting Alabama. Brian Kelly on SiriusXM: first-down success is oxygen for Kiffin tempo (8.1 YPP vs A&M). Reveille in-state ties: $1.53M guarantee, Josh Jackson portal bridge, Will Wade loop.

item.title: Wed Sep 30 - Keys bringing the juice; Kiffin rest plan vs McNeese; Berry seizing snaps
item.description: Davhon Keys ready to start for Weeks: bring the juice with Dottery; delivered on first snap (4th-and-1 stop). Weeks surgery done, no return date; Green targeting ~Alabama Nov 7; Ross/Spears season ACLs. Kiffin extremely cautious vs McNeese; Clark in start conversation; protect Benefield/Umanmielen/Seaton. Harlem Berry seizing RB opportunity. Geralds SEC Freshman of Week. Defense still top-3. Next: McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN.

item.title: Tue Sep 29 - Weeks surgery done, no return date; Kiffin extremely cautious vs McNeese
item.description: Weeks surgery Mon on fractured right fibula; Kiffin: out a while, unclear if returns this season. Extremely cautious with Leavitt; considering sitting standouts vs McNeese; Clark ready. Keys steps up at LB (Ross ACL season). Deuce Geralds SEC Defensive Freshman of Week. Defense still top-3 sacks/run/total. Next: McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN.

item.title: Mon Sep 28 - Weeks surgery Monday; Ross ACL out; LSU slips to No. 11; McNeese next
item.description: Whit Weeks fractured right leg/fibula vs A&M; surgery Mon AM; Kiffin: later in season or not at all; Zenitz/CBS optimism 4-6 weeks possible. Charles Ross II season ACL. Leavitt right hamstring (takes time); Clark ready. AP: LSU 10->11 despite 35-6. Green targeting ~Alabama. Next: McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN.

item.title: Sun Sep 27 - LSU 35-6 A&M; Reed caged; Leavitt gutsy; Weeks crutches
item.description: No. 10 LSU routs No. 23 Texas A&M 35-6 in Death Valley. Baker defense: Reed 106 pass, -13 rush, 4 sacks, 0 TDs. Leavitt 17/23 312 2 TD (hamstring Q2). Harris 6/163/2; Watkins 5/107. Kiffin 4th-and-1 dagger 57-yd TD. Weeks exits crutches/boot (ankle). Next: McNeese Sat 6:45 CT SECN.

item.title: Sat Sep 26 - Gameday vs A&M; Morrow doubtful; Jackson still questionable; Death Valley night
item.description: Gameday: No. 10 LSU hosts No. 23 Texas A&M tonight ~6:30/6:44 CT ABC. Fri SEC sheet: LSU unchanged (Green/Spears/Wright out; Jackson questionable; Cooley available). A&M: Morrow doubtful (was questionable); Bussey out; Bethel-Roman questionable. Cage Reed, protect Leavitt, finish drives. Line ~LSU -8.5, total ~51.5. McElroy 27-20 / Cobb -7.5 still circulating.

item.title: Fri Sep 25 - Cooley available; Jackson questionable; Kiffin fix passing game; one day to A&M
item.description: Thu SEC update: Tamarcus Cooley off report (available); Ja'Keem Jackson upgraded doubtful->questionable; Green/Spears/Wright still out. Kiffin Court To Table radio: fans flipped from fix the run to fix the passing game; Leavitt efficiency needs consistency. McElroy still LSU 27-20; CBS Cobb LSU -7.5; board split on cover. TD buzz: cage Reed, Death Valley night, just beat A&M. Line ~LSU -8.5, total ~51.5. Kick Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Thu Sep 24 - Leavitt off sheet; Jackson doubtful; Kiffin/Elko teleconf; McElroy 27-20
item.description: Wed SEC availability: Sam Leavitt not listed (good); Tamarcus Cooley questionable; Ja'Keem Jackson doubtful; Green/Spears/Wright out. Kiffin SEC teleconf: protect Leavitt, more completions, Reed big test, sarcastic nine-game schedule jab; Elko compliments LSU fight. Greg McElroy picks LSU 27-20. OTB film + Moscona Reed/O-line. TD buzz: Leavitt elite threads, Jhase Thomas PFF All-SEC W3. WAFB/WBRZ: DA investigating alleged 2025 Title IX case (player unnamed). Line ~LSU -8.5/-9. Kick Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Wed Sep 23 - Watkins: Leavitt leading; Benefield actions; ESPN bubble watch
item.description: Tue practice: Winnie Watkins says Sam Leavitt stepped up as locker-room leader after Oxford; Ty Benefield plaster-drill Reed plan + "actions speak louder than words." Spears season-ending ACL; Green miss A&M. ESPN Bubble Watch: LSU CFP ~28%, A&M 13%, loser ≤10%. Stephen A + Finebaum still buy Kiffin title path. Line ~LSU -9. Kick Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Tue Sep 22 - Kiffin confirms Spears ACL; Green miss A&M; Tell the Truth Monday
item.description: Kiffin Monday: Dashawn Spears season-ending ACL confirmed; Trey'Dez Green expected to miss A&M (and possibly more) - Grace/Malachi Thomas on deck. Tell the Truth Monday film hurt - Oxford winnable. Focus: protect Leavitt, finish drives, cage Marcel Reed. Bussey out for A&M season. Finebaum/Barrie: potential elimination game. Line LSU -8.5. Kick Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Mon Sep 21 - Spears ACL season; Green MRI good news; No. 10 hosts A&M
item.description: MRI fallout: Dashawn Spears season-ending ACL (Zenitz/CBS); Trey'Dez Green avoids torn ligaments - sprains/bruises, miss some games (mom FB); Phillip Wright out for year. Poll Mon: LSU 7->10, Ole Miss to No. 4, A&M 9->23. Finebaum closes Kiffin circus; Chase Daniel flags pissed-off Aggies. Next: A&M home Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Sun Sep 20 - Ole Miss 32-24; Chambliss spoils Kiffin return
item.description: No. 8 Ole Miss beats No. 7 LSU 32-24 in Oxford. Chambliss 363 + dagger TD run; LSU rallies from 24-7 to tie then stalls. Leavitt 158/1 INT seal. Green & Spears on crutches. Kiffin: glad it’s over / grateful for 6 years. TD buzz + Tiger Rag autopsy. Next: A&M home Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Sat Sep 19 - Gameday Oxford: Leavitt off final sheet; expected to start
item.description: Game day: Sam Leavitt removed from Friday’s final SEC report after doubtful->questionable week; expected to start vs No. 8 Ole Miss. Saban (McAfee): nothing wrong with Leavitt. Golding got Kiffin text. Finebaum Get Up picks LSU as biggest game of Kiffin career. GameDay Grove + Morgan Freeman. Dottery questionable. Kick 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Fri Sep 18 - Leavitt upgraded to questionable; practiced Thu
item.description: Sam Leavitt upgraded doubtful->questionable after Thu practice (Moscona: back spasms Wed). Kiffin quiet at Court to Table. Stephen A + Finebaum gamesmanship noise; Ole Miss staff skeptical (Thamel). Morgan Freeman GameDay guest picker. Line ~LSU -1.5. Weeks/Green cleared. Kick 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Thu Sep 17 - Leavitt doubtful (shoulder); Clark on deck for Oxford
item.description: Sam Leavitt listed doubtful on SEC sheet - shoulder, did not throw Wed (Zenitz/On3). Landen Clark/Husan Longstreet on deck. Line ~LSU -2.5 after brief dip. Umanmielen served in facility lot; MS DPS largest CFB security package. GameDay Grove Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Wed Sep 16 - Finebaum: must-win for Kiffin; Weeks on Grove heat
item.description: Finebaum Get Up: three yeses - must-win for Kiffin, didn't think he could win at Ole Miss. Whit Weeks: rowdier Grove, Kiffin gonna get it. Oxford PD horse patrols (no Guard). Tiger Rag No. 1 total defense stress test. Moscona Locked On + OTB/AFR, GameDay Grove Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Tue Sep 15 - Kiffin expects hatred; pressure on Ole Miss
item.description: Kiffin Monday presser: hatred/attention on him, pressure on Rebels (Chambliss/Lacy). Landry/ESPN Southern hospitality + security. Golding prep quotes. LSU No. 1 defense / No. 3 offense; Leavitt/OL/Davis watch. TD buzz, Moscona Locked On + OTB/AFR, GameDay Grove Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Mon Sep 14 - No. 7 LSU; Top-10 Armageddon vs Ole Miss
item.description: Poll Monday: LSU No. 7 AP & Coaches (1 first-place coaches vote), Ole Miss No. 8 AP / No. 9 Coaches - first Top-10 Magnolia Bowl since 1962. Tech 45-14 hangover (Leavitt 3 INTs; defense elite). TD buzz, Moscona Locked On + OTB/AFR roundup, LSU favored ~2.5 on road, GameDay Grove Sat 6:30 CT ABC.

item.title: Sun Sep 13 - Tech 45-14; Armageddon Week vs Ole Miss
item.description: Morning-after: No. 8 LSU 45-14 over Louisiana Tech (Leavitt 344 yds/3 rush TDs/3 INTs; defense 140 yds, -3 rush, 7 sacks). TD buzz, OTB/AFR/Locked On roundup, GameDay headed to Oxford, No. 9 Ole Miss next Sat 6:30 CT on ABC.

item.title: Sat Sep 12 - Wear Purple gameday vs Louisiana Tech
item.description: Gameday brief: No. 8 LSU vs Louisiana Tech (6:32 CT, SECN+), Clemson hangover stats, Tiger Droppings score buzz + Fire Sankey billboard, OTB/AFR/Locked On roundup, Finebaum/Rece Davis national noise, Blake Baker vs Blake Baker, Ole Miss next.

item.title: Fri Sep 11 - No SEC sanctions; Tech gameday eve
item.description: SEC presidents meet with no announced sanctions or expulsion vote. Tiger Droppings buzz, Moscona/AFR + Off The Bench YouTube roundup, Louisiana Tech preview (Wear Purple, 6:30 CT, SECN+).

item.title: Voice test - female Hebert-style Cajun
item.description: Short accent test toward Bobby Hebert Cajun Cannon lane (female, not a clone).

item.title: Thu Sep 10 - Expanded sample (SEC vote off, Tech week)
item.description: Expanded ~9 min sample: SEC expulsion vote off after Rousse letter, Tiger Droppings buzz, Off the Bench + After Further Review YouTube roundup, Louisiana Tech preview.
